info.name: GLOBO API
info.description: GLOBO food ordering API (Practice 1). Start a fresh server with npm start and run the folders in order: each create saves the new id in a collection variable that the next requests use. baseUrl = http://localhost:3000/api (resources) · siteUrl = http://localhost:3000 (login and order flow of the web).

exec: pm.test("Only Centro pizzas", () => pm.response.json().forEach(r => { pm.expect(r.area).to.eql("Centro"); pm.expect(r.type).to.eql("pizza"); }));
pm.test("Only area changed", () => { pm.expect(r.area).to.eql("Retiro"); pm.expect(r.name).to.eql("Telepizza Puerta del Sol"); });
pm.test("Filters applied", () => pm.response.json().forEach(d => { pm.expect(d.brand).to.eql("telepizza"); pm.expect(d.category).to.eql("main"); pm.expect(d.price).to.be.within(8, 10); }));
pm.test("Panna Cotta on the menu", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(d => d.name)).to.include("Panna Cotta"));
pm.test("Gets a token and a discount code", () => { pm.expect(u.token).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(u.discountCode).to.match(/^GLOBO-/); });
